breadcrumb: Std 8 Science (English) — Unit 19: Movements in Animals — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Movement is the act of changing the place or position by one or more parts of the body. Movement can be both voluntary and involuntary. For example, walking is a voluntary movement, while breathing is an involuntary movement. In most of the aquatic animals such as fish, whales and shark, locomotion results from a series of wave-like muscle contractions.

en.q: Which of the following is an involuntary movement?
en.explanation: Walking, running and swimming are voluntary movements.

questions.quote: The body of earthworm is made up of many rings joined end to end. Under its body it has a large number of bristles called setae which are connected with muscles. These bristles help to get grip on the ground. A slimy substance secreted by its body helps this movement.

en.q: The bristles on the underside of an earthworm's body that help it grip the ground are called ______.

ta.q: மண்புழுவின் உடலின் அடிப்பகுதியிலுள்ள, தரையைப் பிடித்துக்கொள்ள உதவும் முட்கள் ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: A cockroach has three pairs of jointed legs, which help it to walk, run and climb. It also has two pairs of wings for flying. The body is covered by chitin, a light protective material. Chitin is shed regularly so that the body can grow.

en.q: The body of a cockroach is covered by ______, which is shed regularly so that the body can grow.
en.explanation: A cockroach has three pairs of jointed legs and two pairs of wings.

ta.q: கரப்பான் பூச்சியின் உடல் ______ ஆல் மூடப்பட்டுள்ளது; உடல் வளர அது அவ்வப்போது உதிர்க்கப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: கரப்பானுக்கு மூன்று இணைக் கணுக்கால்களும் இரு இணைச் சிறகுகளும் உண்டு.

questions.quote: Fish: the caudal or tail fin helps in changing direction. Cheetah can run 76 kilometre per hour. The fastest mammal, the dolphin can swim up to 35 miles per hour. Cockroach is the fastest animal with 6 legs covering a metre per second.

en.q: The fin that helps a fish in changing its direction is the ______ fin.
en.explanation: Fish have two paired fins and an unpaired fin. (The caudal fin is the tail fin.)

ta.q: மீன் திசையை மாற்ற உதவும் துடுப்பு ______ துடுப்பு.
ta.explanation: மீன்களுக்கு இணைத் துடுப்புகள் இரண்டும் இணையற்ற துடுப்பு ஒன்றும் உண்டு.

questions.quote: The point at which two separate bones meet is called a joint. Joints can be of three types: fixed, slightly movable and movable joints. The joint between a rib and the breast bone or between the vertebrae is an example of slightly movable joint.

en.q: The joints of a human body can be of ______ types based on movement.
options: four - fixed, hinge, pivot and gliding
three - fixed, slightly movable, freely movable
six - all of them freely movable joints
two - fixed and freely movable only
en.explanation: There are six major types of movable joints.

ta.q: இயக்கத்தின் அடிப்படையில் மனித உடலின் மூட்டுகள் ______ வகைப்படும்.
options: நான்கு - நிலையான, கீல், சுழல், வழுக்கு மூட்டுகள்
மூன்று - நிலையான, சிறிது அசையும், தாராளமாக அசையும்
ta.explanation: தாராளமாக அசையும் மூட்டுகளில் ஆறு முக்கிய வகைகள் உள்ளன.

questions.quote: Table 19.2: Ball and socket - shoulder, hip; Hinge - elbow, knee, ankle; Pivot - spine (atlas/axis joint at the top); Condyloid - wrist; Gliding - spine (between the bony processes of the vertebrae); Saddle - thumb, shoulder and inner ear. Ball and socket allows the greatest range of movement.

en.q: The shoulder and hip are examples of ______ joints.
en.explanation: Ball and socket joints allow the greatest range of movement.

ta.explanation: பந்துக்கிண்ண மூட்டுகள் மிக அதிகமான இயக்கத்தை அனுமதிக்கின்றன.

questions.quote: Inflammation of joints is a condition that usually results either due to friction of articulating cartilage or due to lack of synovial fluid in the joint. This disease is referred to as arthritis. Arthritis is also caused due to the deposition of uric acid crystals in the joints.

en.q: Inflammation of joints, which causes acute pain while moving them, is called ______.
en.explanation: It is also caused by deposition of uric acid crystals in the joints.

ta.q: மூட்டுகள் வீங்கி நகரும்போது கடுமையான வலியை உண்டாக்கும் நிலை ______ எனப்படும்.
ta.explanation: மூட்டுகளில் யூரிக் அமிலப் படிகங்கள் படிவதாலும் இது ஏற்படலாம். (மூட்டழற்சி – ஆர்த்ரைடிஸ்)

questions.quote: Synovial joint features: Ligament - to connect bone to bone; Synovial fluid - slippery fluid to reduce friction; Articular cartilage - glassy-smooth cartilage to absorb shock and prevent friction; Joint capsule - fibrous capsule strengthens the joint, synovial membrane secretes synovial fluid.

en.q: The slippery fluid in a synovial joint reduces friction between the ______.
en.explanation: The synovial membrane secretes synovial fluid.

questions.quote: The femur or thighbone is the longest and strongest bone of the human skeleton. The stapes in the middle ear is the smallest and lightest bone of the human skeleton.

en.q: The smallest and lightest bone of the human skeleton is the ______.
en.explanation: The femur is the longest and strongest bone.

ta.q: மனித எலும்புக்கூட்டின் மிகச் சிறிய, மிக இலேசான எலும்பு ______.
ta.explanation: தொடை எலும்பு (ஃபீமர்) மிக நீளமான, வலிமையான எலும்பு. (ஸ்டேப்ஸ் நடுக்காதில் உள்ளது.)

questions.quote: Bones: Long bones - found in arms and legs; Short bones - wrist, ankle, vertebral column; Flat bones - skull, ribs, shoulder and hips; Irregular bones - spine and vertebral column, mandible. Bones comprise the hard framework of the body. Cartilages are the supporting and connecting structures. Ligaments bind the bones together.

en.q: Long bones are found in the ______.
en.explanation: Flat bones are found in the skull, ribs, shoulder and hips.

ta.explanation: தட்டை எலும்புகள் மண்டை ஓடு, விலா எலும்பு, தோள், இடுப்பில் உள்ளன.

questions.quote: Vertebral column is also called spine or backbone. It consists of 7 cervical vertebrae, 12 thoracic vertebrae, 5 lumbar vertebrae, 5 fused sacral and 3 fused coccygeal vertebrae. The spinal cord passes through this hollow tube.

en.q: The spinal cord passes through the hollow tube formed by the ______.
en.explanation: The vertebral column protects the spinal cord.

ta.q: தண்டுவடம் ______ உருவாக்கும் உள்ளீடற்ற குழாய் வழியே செல்கிறது.

questions.quote: Rib cage occupies the chest region. It is a cone-shaped structure made up of twelve pairs of ribs. Ten pairs of ribs are attached to the breast bone at the front. Two pairs of lower ribs are free at front. These are called free-floating ribs. Rib cage protects the underlying lungs, heart and some part of liver.

en.q: The two pairs of lower ribs that are free at the front are called ______ ribs.
en.explanation: Ten pairs of ribs are attached to the breast bone at the front.

ta.q: முன்பக்கத்தில் இணையாத கீழ்ப்புற இரு இணை விலா எலும்புகள் ______ விலா எலும்புகள் எனப்படும்.
ta.explanation: பத்து இணை விலா எலும்புகள் முன்புறம் மார்பெலும்புடன் இணைந்துள்ளன.

questions.quote: Shoulder bones are formed by the collar bone (clavicle) at the front and the shoulder blade (scapula) at the back. The shoulder blade has a socket like cavity into which fits the ball of the upper arm bone. This forms a ball and socket joint. Humans and giraffes have the same number of bones in the necks.

en.q: The pectoral (shoulder) girdle is formed by the ______.
options: radius and ulna of the forearm
femur and tibia of the leg
sternum and ribs of the chest
en.explanation: The shoulder blade forms a ball and socket joint with the humerus. (The collar bone is the clavicle; the shoulder blade is the scapula.)

ta.explanation: தோள்பட்டை எலும்பு புயவெலும்புடன் பந்துக்கிண்ண மூட்டை உருவாக்குகிறது. (காரை எலும்பு – கிளவிக்கிள்; தோள்பட்டை எலும்பு – ஸ்கேபுலா)

questions.quote: Upper limb bones consist of humerus, radius, ulna, carpals, metacarpals and phalanges. Humerus makes up the upper arm. Fore-arm is made up of radius and ulna. Wrist is made up of carpals. Palm is made up of metacarpals. Fingers are made up of phalanges. Lower limb: femur (thigh), tibia and fibula (leg), tarsals, metatarsals and phalanges. Knee is covered by the patella.

en.q: The forearm is made up of the ______.
en.explanation: The humerus makes up the upper arm; the tibia and fibula make up the leg.

ta.explanation: புயவெலும்பு மேற்கையையும் டிபியா, ஃபிபுலா கால்பகுதியையும் உருவாக்குகின்றன.

questions.quote: Each muscle usually has two ends - a fixed end where the muscle originates and a movable end which pulls some other part. This movable end is drawn out to form a tough structure the tendon which is attached to the bone. Muscles often work in pairs which work against each other: antagonistic pairs. Facts: It takes 17 muscles to smile and 42 muscles to frown. The hardest working muscle is in the eye.

en.q: A tough structure that connects a muscle to a bone is the ______.
en.explanation: When stimulated by a nerve the muscle contracts to become shorter and thicker.

ta.explanation: நரம்பால் தூண்டப்படும்போது தசை சுருங்கிக் குட்டையாகவும் தடிமனாகவும் மாறுகிறது. (தசைநாண் – டெண்டன்)

questions.quote: Table 19.4 Types of muscles: Striated/skeletal/voluntary muscle - attached to bones, multinucleate, unbranched, voluntary. Non-striated/smooth/involuntary - single central nucleus, involuntary. Cardiac - heart, branched, 1-3 central nuclei, involuntary.

en.q: Which type of muscle is found in the heart?
en.explanation: Cardiac muscle is branched with 1-3 central nuclei and is involuntary.

ta.explanation: இதயத் தசை கிளைத்தது; 1-3 மையக் கருக்களைக் கொண்டது; தன்னிச்சையற்றது.

questions.quote: Bones and cartilage form the skeleton of the human body. The bones are moved by alternate contractions and relaxations of two sets of muscles. Earthworms move by alternate extension and contraction of the body using muscles; tiny bristles on the underside help in gripping the ground. Fish swim by forming loops alternately on two sides of the body.

en.q: The bones are moved by alternate contractions and relaxations of ______.
en.explanation: Muscles can pull bones but cannot push them back, so they work in pairs of flexors and extensors.

ta.q: எலும்புகள் ______ மாறி மாறிச் சுருங்கித் தளர்வதால் இயங்குகின்றன.
ta.explanation: தசைகள் எலும்புகளை இழுக்கவே முடியும்; தள்ள முடியாது; எனவே வளைப்பி, நீட்டி இணைகளாகச் செயல்படுகின்றன.
